note: Ground truth for FixtureQA and scoring. Not shown during the demo.

bugs.symptom: Editing a task, cancelling, then opening Edit on a different task shows the first task's abandoned draft. Saving overwrites the second task with the first task's text.
repro: Click Edit on 'Review pull request #412'
Change the Title field to 'ZZZ'
Click Cancel
Click Edit on 'Renew the TLS certificate'
Observe: Title reads 'ZZZ' instead of 'Renew the TLS certificate'
bugs.root_cause: openEdit() seeds editDraft with `editDraft = editDraft || {...}`, so it is only initialised when null. closeModal() only toggles the .hidden class and never nulls editDraft; only saveEdit() clears it.

bugs.symptom: Discarded settings changes reappear on reopen, so the settings UI disagrees with persisted state.
repro: Click Settings
Untick 'Ask before deleting a task' and change Display name
Click Cancel
Click Settings again
Observe: the discarded values are shown as though saved
bugs.root_cause: openSettings() seeds settingsDraft with `settingsDraft = settingsDraft || {...}`. The close path never nulls settingsDraft, so the stale draft shadows the real settings object on reopen.

bugs.symptom: After cancelling one delete confirmation, the next delete confirmation names the previous task and deletes the wrong task on confirm. Data loss.
repro: Click Delete on 'Draft the Q3 release notes'
Click Cancel
Click Delete on 'Renew the TLS certificate'
Observe: dialog reads 'Delete "Draft the Q3 release notes"?'
Click Delete — the wrong task is removed
bugs.root_cause: requestDelete() seeds pendingDelete with `pendingDelete = pendingDelete || {id, title}`. Cancelling closes the dialog without nulling pendingDelete, so the stale target survives into the next confirmation.

bugs.symptom: The remaining-tasks counter is always one lower than the true count, and reads '-1 tasks remaining' when the list is empty.
repro: Observe the counter with 3 incomplete tasks — it reads '2 tasks remaining'
Complete every task — it reads '-1 tasks remaining'
bugs.root_cause: render() computes `tasks.filter(t => !t.done).length - 1`. The -1 compensated for a pinned 'inbox' row that was removed from the markup; the compensation was left behind.

bugs.symptom: Selecting a filter then adding or completing a task silently reverts the list to 'All' while the selected chip stays highlighted.
repro: Click the 'Done' filter chip
Tick the checkbox on any task
Observe: all tasks are listed again, but 'Done' still looks selected
bugs.root_cause: addTask() and toggleTask() both assign `activeFilter = 'all'` before render() so the mutated task is guaranteed visible, but neither updates the .is-active chip class. Control and state desync.

bugs.symptom: Pressing Enter while editing a task title reloads the whole page and silently discards the edit.
repro: Click Edit on any task
Type in the Title field
Press Enter
Observe: full page navigation, edit lost
bugs.root_cause: #edit-form is a real <form> containing exactly one implicit-submission-blocking field and no submit listener, so Enter triggers native GET submission to the same URL. No preventDefault anywhere.

bugs.symptom: The toast notification's × button does nothing; the toast never dismisses and overlaps the Settings button.
repro: Load the page — the welcome toast appears top-right
Click the × on the toast
Observe: nothing happens, ever
bugs.root_cause: init() binds the click listener to $('#toast-dismiss'), an id that does not exist in the markup (the button is #toast-close). The `if (toastX)` guard swallows the miss silently.

bugs.symptom: Whitespace-only input creates blank task rows, repeatable indefinitely.
repro: Type a single space into the new-task input
Click 'Add task'
Observe: an empty task row is created and persisted
bugs.root_cause: addTask() guards on `title.length === 0` rather than `title.trim().length === 0`, so whitespace-only input passes validation and is stored verbatim.
